[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Brax''' was a member of [[Raven Squad]], a [[Imperial Special Forces (Sith Empire)|Special Forces]] unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was deployed on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]]. While on a scouting mission for [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]], Brax spotted an Imperial supply drop in the area, but was pinned down by hostile [[Mutated Geonosian]]s before he could reach it.<ref name="JUS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brax first appears in the ''Jedi Under Siege'' expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="JUS" />

In the Imperial storyline, Brax retreated to a nearby cave, where he was located and rescued by Major Anri and the [[Alliance Commander]]. After Brax expressed his excitement over meeting the famous Commander, Major Anri ordered him to return to base and tend to his wounds.<ref name="JUS" />

In the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|Onslaught]]'' expansion, if the player is a Republic Saboteur, Anri will call out Brax's name if the Commander kills [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Dol Narlock]] on [[Mek-Sha]], asking if he is still alive. This leaves his ultimate fate unknown.<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>
